name: Xbox 360 Wireless Controller
notes: Wireless receiver, not the controller itself. The receiver is the USB device, and individual wireless controllers have no USB PIDs. The real protocol uses a vendor-specific USB class (0xFF/0x5D/0x01), and the receiver-side driver presents a standard Xbox 360 HID descriptor on its bus child for each paired controller. The shipped descriptor adds an HM-specific Vx (0x40) + Vy (0x41) Physical Collection so the BuildReportInto combined-Z synthesis can populate joy.cpl Z from (rt - lt) while routing separate LT / RT to Vx / Vy for WGI / XInput. PID 0x0291 is the v2 receiver. Routes through hidmaestro_xusb.inf XUSB companion (matches xbox-360-wired path), with no xinputhid driver mode, which would force the 16-button gamepad layout and break subtype fidelity.
